description: This file defines a Remix route component for editing a note, including data loaders, actions, meta information, and UI components for rendering the note editing form.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Provides meta information for the page, such as title and description, based on the note data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches the note data based on URL parameters; throws a 404 if not found.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission to update the note; redirects after success or throws 404 if note not found.

methods.name: EditNoteRoute
methods.description: React component rendering the note editing form, utilizing loader data and navigation state.
